inference_budget: reuse matching assets, at most6 logical candidates; no reward rerun or new sampling/download; exact input/asset hashes saved
exploration: A isotropic raw Gaussian. B fixed full-rank Gaussian covariance with additional variance along traceable native directions. Whitened Gaussian u, executed raw=L*u, legal z=16raw/||raw||. Full covariance via fixed invertible Cholesky, exact raw density differs by constant logdet. Original probability/KL/Adam checks unchanged. No expert overwrite, mixture, task selector or deployment proposal.
initialization: Fresh actor/critic/normalizer, standing final bias; optional shared native continuation-only supervised initialization; never I/C0/T30 weights or default labels. Original native entry frames excluded when identical observations would carry clock-chosen inconsistent labels.
selection: Within each arm same dev rule: .5*max relative physical cost + mean relative cost; reject native safety boundary or worst >1.75x initial. Initial included; dev-only selection. Report per-family and tail; no final reselection.
extension: Both arms finish32 first. Extend both to64 only if both have no safety failures and at least one has >=5% development aggregate improvement without any family >1.5x initial; otherwise both stop32. Resource reserve may shorten equally. Final not opened before selection.

physical.reward: unchanged geometry_env per-point physical cost and absorbing terminal treatment

actor_permissions: current privileged partner error/relative velocity, current proprio/history, per-point actual forces and actual last-z; no taskID, future, final distance, globalclock or sourceID
source_prefix: same live MuJoCo instance through native source execution to selected handoff; no reset/qpos-only/history erase at takeover
C0_role: frozen final reference only; no new mechanism training, no gating of native mainline
